summary: Movement order of an Act 3 crowd character (lower-city civilians walking their splines / detours): target, last seen position, arrival radius, a path state and a stuck counter. Created and driven by esv::crowds::CharacterMovementSystem::Update from the MoveTo/Detour/Patrol request singletons. Saved: model game.crowds.v0.MoveToComponent (32 bytes, alignment 4); bg3.exe+0x25FB4C0 loads it back (two vec3 through a level-offset transform, then the rest).

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xD8C530 CharacterMovementSystem::Update copies the request's position (+0..+0xB, request stride 0x14) to +0..+0xB; the distance from the character to +0..+8 is compared with the radius at +0x18; live world coordinates

fields.name: LastPosition
fields.evidence: Update copies the character's ls::TransformComponent translation (+0x10..+0x18) to +0xC..+0x14 and each frame compares the current position with it (epsilon 1.19e-7) to detect a character that does not move

fields.name: Radius
fields.evidence: Update copies request+0xC here; arrival when squared distance <= radius^2; increased by 0.05 when the character is stuck for 30 frames; live 0.5..3.3

fields.name: field_1c
fields.evidence: Update zeroes it when a request arrives and when stuck; compared with an id at +0x10 of another object (a path/request id); live 0..0x3E1

fields.name: StuckFrames
fields.evidence: Update increments the byte at +0x20 while the position is unchanged and resets it at 30 (0x1E) or when the character moves; live 0

fields.name: field_21
fields.evidence: Update copies the request's byte at +0x10 here (a movement kind/speed enum?); live 1..4
